subject: Partner onboarding MOP & lead gating policy
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Kyle Matthews <kyle@integral.tools>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-30T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Partner onboarding MOP & lead gating policy

Hi Kyle —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier. Attached is our proposed onboarding Method-of-Procedure (MOP) and the starter commission matrix for referral/reseller flows. High-level asks and items we want to align on before kickoff: 

- Lead registration: partner registers inbound opportunities in HubSpot using the shared form (link below). Registered lead gets 90-day protection on sourced or influenced opportunities.
- Protection scope: credit applies to first paid contract signed within protection window; co-sourced deals require documented influence (joint demo, co-signed MQL).
- Commission structure: 10% referral on first-year subscription ARR for direct referrals; tiered rev-share for reseller-managed accounts (see Commission_Matrix_v1.xlsx).
- Onboarding steps (proposed): intro + legal, technical enablement, joint GTM materials, co-marketing demo within 3 weeks.
- Required artifacts: completed security questionnaire, SOC 2 snapshot if requested, and signed SOW.

Attachments: Partner_Onboarding_MOP_v1.pdf, Commission_Matrix_v1.xlsx
HubSpot lead form: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/2047

Can you confirm the protection window and whether a 90-day period works for Integral? If you prefer, we can split protected windows by lead type (inbound vs. marketing-introduced).

Proposed next step: 30-min kickoff on June 3 — are you available?

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

From: Kyle Matthews <kyle@integral.tools>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Liu <samantha@edge-consulting.com>, Jane Park <jane.legal@integral.tools>
Date: 2026-05-30T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner onboarding MOP & lead gating policy

Jonas —

Appreciate the clear doc. A couple quick asks from our side: 

1) Protection window — 90 days is a bit long for our workflows. Could we do 60 days instead? 
2) Commission split — the 10% referral is fine, but for reseller-managed deals we usually ask for a minimum floor (e.g., 7% rev-share guaranteed) if we take full sales ownership. Can you add a floor to the matrix?
3) Co-branded demo — our sales engineering team would like a co-branded demo template that we can use during qualification. That will help prove influence for joint-opps.

We also will need the MOP to include a requirement that Redwood helps supply an SE for the first three joint demos (to ensure success) — can you confirm?

Happy to have our legal take a look once you send a redline. Kickoff on June 3 might be tight; June 4 (morning PDT) works for our team.

—Kyle
Kyle Matthews
Head of Strategic Integrations, Integral Tools

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-30T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Partner onboarding MOP & lead gating policy — Integral asks

Looping internal team with Kyle's asks so we can scope changes quickly. My take:

- Protection window compromise: propose 75 days. Splitting by lead type adds complexity; offer standard 75 days for inbound + 45 days for marketing-introduced (campaigns) as an alternate clause.
- Commission floor: agree to add 7% floor for reseller-managed deals where Integral owns SOW and post-sale support. We'll show the math in the matrix and call out booking attribution rules.
- SE support: ok to commit SE shadow for first 3 demos (time-boxed) — include in the MOP under "enablement commitments" but limit to joint-qualified opps only.

Attaching a quick redline with inline comments: MOP_redline_kyle_comments.pdf

Action items:
1) Jonas — update MOP and Commission_Matrix to reflect 75-day protection and 7% floor, then send to Kyle and Jane for legal.
2) Camila — prepare co-branded demo template (simple deck + one-pager) and draft SE staffing note.
3) Ben — I'll need a quick revenue recognition note for reseller rev-share (we bill partner or gross vs net).

If we can get the redline to their legal by EOD tomorrow, we can still make a June 4 kickoff.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-31T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner onboarding MOP & lead gating policy — legal/finance notes

Thanks for the summary. A few legal/finance items we need in the MOP and SOW before we sign: 

- Add a clear definition of "protected lead" (registration form timestamp + contact verification).
- Limit protection to 75 days (per Marissa) and add clause for "materially similar" existing opportunities exclusion.
- Commission schedule needs a payment milestone table and a single point-of-contact for invoicing; suggest net-30 payment terms to partner with statement of work referencing Redwood's billing entity.
- Compliance: include requirement for partner to provide a current SOC 2 report or agree to our data handling addendum.

I'll circulate a short redline and prepare a DocuSign envelope once we have agreement on the protection and commission floor.

DocuSign draft link: https://www.docusign.com/contract/5a4b3c2d

Aisha Rahman
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kyle Matthews <kyle@integral.tools>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-01T08:00:00-07:00
Subject: Final terms + scheduled kickoff (Integral Tools)

Kyle / team —

Thanks for the quick back-and-forth. Per internal alignment, here are the agreed terms we will include in the SOW and onboarding packet: 

- Protection window: 75 days for inbound; 45 days for marketing campaign-sourced leads.
- Commission: 10% referral on first-year ARR; reseller-managed deals get a floor of 7% (see Commission_Matrix_v1.xlsx for tiering).
- SE support: Redwood will provide an SE for the first three joint-qualified demos.
- Invoicing: Redwood will issue invoices to Integral under net-30; revenue share payments to Integral per schedule in SOW.
- Compliance: Integral to provide SOC 2 snapshot or sign Redwood's Data Handling Addendum prior to production access.

Attachments: Signed_SOW_Integral_2026.pdf (attached here for records); we'll push the DocuSign envelope after Jane's sign-off. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/2047 (deal RDW-DEAL-2026-1457)

Kickoff: Confirming June 4, 2026 at 10:00 AM PDT for a 30-min kickoff (calendar invite sent).

Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Kyle Matthews <kyle@integral.tools>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jane Park <jane.legal@integral.tools>
Date: 2026-06-01T11:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final terms + scheduled kickoff (Integral Tools)

Ben —

Thanks — all sounds good from our side. Jane will sign the DocuSign tonight and we’ll upload our SOC 2 snapshot to the shared Drive folder. Looking forward to the kickoff on June 4.

Kyle
